lines.t: I want to come to you to feel your love.
So true love that makes me feel a joy.
A joy so strong that never fades, it never slumbers, it never goes away.
I want to come to you, Lord, and be filled with this joy.
A flood of joy that reaches into the deepest parts of me,
into the hidden places that only you see.
A joy that seeps into the innermost parts,
crafted by your fingertips.
tears, a joy that causes words of praise to you to forever be on my lips. All I want is to feel
The joy of you, Lord
All I want is to feel your love
The love that surpasses time and space
A love found in every place
A love cleansing every part
A love that will never depart
A place of perfect peace
Of undefiled love
Love and joy from above
Lord, I know I was never alone
That to you I was never unknown
You are with me and in me
You are the blood of my veins
The salt of my tears
Healing wounds, washing away my fears
You said, oh my beloved, let me wipe them away
Even everyone, numbering them, accounting them unto love's purpose.
Lord, I'll gladly let you.
Lord, all I want is to feel your love.
To feel this joy from above
You are the fulfillment of all things
The bright light shining on the cloudy day
In your arms, heaven and earth pass away
Perfect fulfillment remains
Me united to you in love
A perfect love
A love that brings forth a perfect joy
A feeling only you can employ
Thank you.
We'll see you next time.
